body:
Founder real-time: 'can you update shankpit so CTF with bots' -> 'that mode should pick voxworld or the oil tanker not just the oil tanker figure it out.' local_init_match's MODE_CTFB branch hardcoded SCENE_OIL_TANKER unconditionally; TDM-with-bots (MODE_TDMB) right above it already randomizes maps via scene_random_tdmb_map(). New scene_random_ctfb_map() scoped to exactly Voxworld+Oil Tanker (not the full 5-map TDMB rotation) -- confirmed via get_ctf_flag_home/get_ctf_pedestal_anchor that only these two scenes have real CTF flag/pedestal placement, every other map falls back to a generic non-CTF marker. apps/server/src/main.c compiles clean. SHANKPIT 1bdd26f.

⚓ ☃
title: CTF-with-bots now randomly picks Voxworld or Oil Tanker, not just Oil Tanker
